title: [GMCP 203.027.06] Operations and evidence: Enterprise and machine-to-machine authorization extensions
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-027-06. Ship inspectable CLI, TUI or API state, configuration validation, bounded metrics/logs/traces, diagnostics, examples, migration and rollback guidance, incident runbooks, and reproducible evidence artifacts. Automate drift detection so a changed dependency or standard invalidates stale proof. Vector outcome: GMCP implements and tests official enterprise-managed authorization and OAuth client-credentials extension profiles without conflating user and workload identity. Policy chooses flows explicitly, administrators can constrain issuers and clients, managed settings are tamper-evident, credentials are audience-bound and rotated, and unsupported or draft profiles are labeled and safely declined. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
